race.description: Tradies Race Day - Friday 18 Sept Hcp (Bm70)
race.comment: NOLAN (2) has a handy record over this course and distance with a win and two placings from six attempts and gets a bunch of weight off with the 3kg claim. Hails from an astute barn and should be right there when the judge calls a halt. DEMITASSE (3) got the job done at the Gold Coast two back before not being disgraced in the Noosa Cup last time out. Should find this a touch easier. CHARTWELL (9) is a two-time winner here who will be cherry-ripe fit for this. In the mix. HOT DIGITY BOOM (1) has gotten better with each run this time in work and looks to be building up to another victory. Don't dismiss lightly. FIVE STAR KING (11) is a last-start winner who shouldn't be underestimated.
